page.overview:
What is Kone Kone no Mi?

The Kone Kone no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to transform individuals into different people. It was eaten by Bildy.

The main strength of the fruit is being able to turn normal people into copies of others, giving them the appearance, abilities, and strength of those they are copying. This gives the user great strength when they have subordinates who can follow commands in their new, stronger forms. With this strength, Bildy helped Smash establish the DX Marines and take over Madatascar Island when, in reality, the two of them are the only notable members.

One unique weakness is that people who are transformed return to their original state once they are incapacitated. Furthermore, the user cannot transform themselves. Otherwise, the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses apply as well.

Bildly uses his abilities to make an army of specialized warriors for the DX Marines. He has made fake versions of the following:
